note: Ensemble score = w_rf*mean_rf_risk + w_gnn*gnn_chain_prob + w_escape*escape_signal. escape_signal = 1.0 if ANY node has an ESCAPE_FLAG set, else 0.0 (binary). ESCAPE_FLAG_INDICES derived from kubescan FEATURE_COLS in 26-dim node feature vector. Objective includes a floor penalty (reg_lambda * shortfall below min_weight per weight) that discourages degenerate zero-weight solutions (see audit/model_fixes.md) and a chain-MRR tie-breaker (mrr_weight * mean reciprocal rank of true chains) that orders solutions within a P@k plateau; see audit/gnn_p5_refit_2026-07-14.md.
